lessons.title: No column-fodder RFPs
lessons.rule: Bid on an RFP only if we were engaged with a sponsor before it was issued; with 5+ competitors and no prior contact, decline.
lessons.trigger: rfp_invitation, or any lead where we had no contact before the request and there are many competitors
lessons.action_required: Escalate as no-bid unless a sponsor is named; record why.

lessons.title: Government payment cycles
lessons.rule: Government, PSU or state-owned buyers (including subsidiaries, and GeM-portal bids) need milestone billing or a mobilisation advance before we qualify.
lessons.trigger: Buyer is government, a PSU, state-owned, or a subsidiary of one
lessons.action_required: Escalate with billing safeguards; never accept certification-only payment.

lessons.title: Paid pilots only
lessons.rule: Any 'free pilot' or no-cost proof of concept becomes a paid pilot with fixed scope, duration and exit criteria.
lessons.trigger: Request mentions a free pilot, PoC at no cost, or trial before commitment

lessons.title: Clear overdue before expanding
lessons.rule: Never expand an account with invoices overdue beyond 60 days until cleared or secured.
lessons.trigger: Existing client with invoices overdue beyond 60 days
lessons.action_required: Ask: hold the upsell until overdue is cleared or an advance is agreed.
